_about: tools/budget.mjs compares the built game with these. budget+tol: at most budget*(1+tol); target+tol: within target*(1+-tol); max: at most max. Bytes are deterministic (CI checks them); perf numbers are from one machine, so only `npm run budget` locally checks them. Reseed with `node tools/budget.mjs --seed` after a deliberate change, on a quiet machine.

perf.method: median of three sessions, each the median of 3 runs
perf.load: load average 9-19 on 12 cores (other agents running headless Chrome); quieter machines will read lower
perf.cpu: Apple M2 Pro x12, Chrome 154 with its GPU

bytes.critical.new.about: what a new tank fetches before its first frame: page + main bundle + wasm + .riv + moon sprites

load.new.fast4g.firstFrame.about: a new tank's first frame over fast 4G (9 Mbps, 85 ms)

load.new.slow4g.firstFrame.about: the same over slow 4G (1.6 Mbps, 150 ms)

load.new.fast4g.kbBeforeFirstFrame.about: KB transferred by the first frame

battery.idle.main.about: an idle settled tank main-thread CPU, 1x. 25%: the three seeding sessions read 114, 123 and 142 on one machine

battery.idle.fps.about: an idle tank drops to its calm 30 fps (more is a battery regression, less a stutter)

battery.hidden.main.about: and does next to no work
